What is the Atlantis ERP?

The Atlantis ERP is a fully customized ERP solution for NDT and inspection companies, set up and supported by Atlantis NDT. It connects the full life of an inspection job, from the first enquiry to the paid invoice, in one system built around certified technicians, calibrated equipment, approved procedures and signed reports. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and quoted on request.

This page is a module-by-module tour. Each section below explains what one app does for an NDT service company, which buyer problem it solves, and links to the app's own page. Read it in order and you follow a job the way it moves through a typical inspection contractor in the USA or Canada: a lead comes in, a quote goes out, a project is opened, a crew is dispatched with calibrated equipment and a current procedure, reports are written and approved, time is approved, and the client is invoiced. If you are comparing technician certification tracking software, calibration management software for NDT, crew dispatch software for inspection companies or NDT quoting software, each of those needs is covered here as part of one connected ERP rather than as separate tools that do not talk to each other.

How the Atlantis ERP apps fit together

The apps share one database, so a technician's certificate, an instrument's calibration and a job's timesheet are never re-keyed between tools. That is the practical difference between an ERP and a collection of point solutions.

  • Win the work: CRM, Quotations, Website, Email Marketing and Business Cards.
  • Plan and staff it: Project, Team Assignments, Employees, Time Off and Fleet.
  • Stay compliant: Certificates, Procedures, Asset Management, Maintenance and Surveys.
  • Do the inspection: NDT Reports with Digital Twin Reporting and the offline field app.
  • Get paid: Timesheets, Expenses, Invoicing and Dashboards.
  • Grow the team: eLearning with Practical NDT.

The full list is on the ERP apps page.

CRM for NDT service lines

The CRM app is set up for how inspection work is actually sold. A lead records the service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and the estimated technicians and days, so your sales team can tell a two-day PT job from a six-week turnaround enquiry at a glance.

Each lead gets an NDT lead score from 0 to 100, grouped as hot, warm, nurture or cold. Leads can be imported from CSV, previewed with an AI-personalised email, and enrolled in a drip email sequence by service line, with pause, resume and unsubscribe handled. The AI Marketing features generate newsletter, promotion, nurture and announcement emails using an AI model that can run on your own server. Business Cards turns a photo of a card collected at a trade show into a lead or mailing-list contact in one click, which is handy after events such as ASNT's annual conference or a regional pipeline and refining show.

NDT quoting software: the Quotations app

NDT quoting software needs to price labour by technician level and by method, not just list products. The Quotations app does that by treating each NDT service as a product flagged with method and category.

A quote carries the job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, so a refinery buyer sees that you are quoting to ASME Section V or the client's own specification. Your charging structure, whether that is Level II and Level III by the day or shift, overtime, standby, mobilisation, equipment and consumables, is loaded as service products during implementation. A global discount can be applied, the PDF is branded to your company, and the client can accept and sign online. An accepted quote converts to a sales order, which becomes the starting point for the project and, later, the invoice.

Projects built for inspection jobs

The Project app holds everything a job supervisor needs on one screen: NDT job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, job status, and safety induction and work permit fields.

Tasks inside the project carry the method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, and procedure and WPS references. That means a project manager can see how many welds have been examined by RT, how many indications were recorded and which procedure revision was used, without opening each report. For plant turnarounds in Texas, Louisiana or Alberta, where one client project can involve several crews and methods at once, this is where the scope is kept straight.

Crew dispatch software for inspection companies: Team Assignments

Crew dispatch software for inspection companies has to stop two things: sending someone who is not qualified, and promising the same person or instrument to two clients. The Team Assignments app does both.

Jobs are dispatched as team assignments that move from planned to dispatched, in field, submitted and closed. Each has site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The technician availability calendar marks assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and overlaps are blocked. Double-booking of technicians and of equipment serial numbers is blocked, and the system warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration. For each technician you see status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date, in calendar, kanban and list views. Time Off feeds this availability directly, and the Fleet app assigns vehicles to projects and drivers with dates and mileage, including whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources and its transport licence number and expiry.

Technician certification tracking software: the Certificates app

Technician certification tracking software for NDT has to follow the scheme, level and method, not only a date. The Certificates app records each certification with scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level (trainee, I, II, III), method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam result and attachments.

Status is computed automatically as active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked, with Expiring Soon and Expired menus for the quality manager. Vision tests record near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast, with examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry. Examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores. Certificate templates per scheme hold validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours. Daily checks raise warning tasks 90 days ahead, configurable daily email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. Company certifications, such as your ISO certificate and other accreditations, are tracked with their own alert days. The employee NDT profile shows highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry; see the Employees app.

Procedures with controlled revisions

The Procedures app is a procedure register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria, and either body text or an uploaded file. Methods covered include UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more.

Procedures run through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states. Prepared, reviewed and approved by are recorded with dates, approved revisions are locked, and rejections carry a reason. Every revision keeps a snapshot, so you can show an auditor exactly what the procedure said on the day a job was done. An AI-assisted first draft can speed up writing a new procedure, falling back to a built-in template, but a Level III still reviews and approves it. Approvers get email notifications and reminders for anything waiting on them.

Calibration management software for NDT: Asset Management

Calibration management software for NDT has to work at serial-number level and connect to dispatch. The Asset Management app tracks every flaw detector, PAUT unit, probe, yoke and source-related item by serial number, with equipment type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories, calibration frequency and status, and a lifecycle of new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Rental rates you charge clients can be recorded against the equipment.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, an accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result, and next due date. The calibration certificate register holds the lab accreditation number, PDF and a valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Issue and return go through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded both ways, reservations prevent clashes, and movements in and out are logged. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, chemicals and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. The Maintenance app handles preventive and corrective requests on instruments, vehicles and site equipment, the Inventory app holds stock by serial, and the Purchase app records vendor types (OEM, dealer, calibration lab), accredited-lab status with accreditation number and expiry, and order lines tied to a specific equipment serial.

NDT Reports and Digital Twin Reporting

The NDT Reports app is where the inspection itself is recorded, and it is the heart of the Atlantis ERP. It includes Digital Twin Reporting Software, our reporting engine for field and office.

There are 17 report types, each with its own numbering: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography. Method-specific data is captured properly: UT probe calibration tables, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws, MFL scan mode, UT thickness readings by direction, and weld lines with defect type and orientation. Reports move from draft to in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer, approver and third-party or authorized inspector signatures, and references to work order, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML keep your branding, and Excel templates fill automatically from mapped cells.

In the field, technicians use an installable web app that works without signal, stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs later, with a method picker, photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview. Marine inspection companies get a vessel cover page and a PDF that merges the classification-society certificate, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate. When results need to be seen in 3D, Atlantis Digital Twins visualises inspection data on the asset, with damage and indication mapping and thickness and remaining-life trends.

Timesheets, Expenses and Invoicing

The Timesheets app records work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client, equipment serial and approval, and warns if the technician's certificate is not valid. Approved billable time feeds billing, so standby and travel days reach the invoice.

The Invoicing app carries the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector on the header, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Lines show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, with a custom invoice layout. Payments, reminders and taxes, including US state sales tax or Canadian GST/HST and PST, are configured per country during implementation. The Expenses app handles field expenses and per diems re-billed to jobs.

Dashboards for owners and quality managers

The Dashboards app gives spreadsheet-style KPI dashboards. NDT KPIs include equipment calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over 12 months. Owners get the money view; quality managers get the compliance view; both come from the same live data.

eLearning and Practical NDT

The eLearning app runs your internal training portal, with Level I, II and III sections, video lessons streamed from OneDrive or SharePoint with download protection, quizzes whose questions can be imported from Word files, and certificates of completion. Admins create learner accounts and grant or revoke access, learners have their own dashboard, invited members join automatically, and courses can be sold online.

The Practical NDT section links to Practical NDT, our 3D practice simulator, so trainees can rehearse technique before touching real equipment. Atlantis NDT's own training follows ASNT SNT-TC-1A; the eLearning records sit alongside the training hours logged in the Certificates app.

Custom apps built on request

If your company has a workflow none of the standard apps covers, a custom app can be built on request and connected to the same data. The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. See custom apps or describe the workflow you need.

Frequently asked questions

What does the Atlantis ERP include?

It includes apps for CRM, quotations, projects, team assignments, certificates, procedures, asset management and calibration, NDT reports, timesheets, invoicing, dashboards, eLearning and more, all configured for NDT companies and customized during implementation.

Is the Atlantis ERP good technician certification tracking software?

Yes. It tracks scheme, level, method, OJT and training hours, exams and vision tests, computes status automatically, warns 90 days before expiry and flags timesheets for technicians without a valid certificate.

Can it work as calibration management software for NDT on its own?

You can start with Asset Management for calibration and add apps later, though the biggest benefit comes from linking calibration status to dispatch so out-of-calibration equipment is flagged before it leaves the yard.

Do I have to take every app?

No. You choose the apps you need, and the scope and quote reflect that. Many small companies start with Certificates, Asset Management, NDT Reports, Timesheets and Invoicing.

Where is Digital Twin Reporting in the ERP?

Digital Twin Reporting sits under the NDT Reports app. It covers the 17 report types, approval workflow, branded templates and the offline field app.

How much does the Atlantis ERP cost?

Pricing is by quote on request, based on the apps, templates, integrations and custom work in scope. Book a demo and get a quote.
